stem:
This diagram describes events in civil rights history.

President Truman establishes the President’s Commission on Civil Rights in 1946.
The Commission recommends protecting and strengthening civil rights for people.
Southern senators threaten to filibuster legislation that would expand civil rights.

Which 1948 action correctly replaces the question mark in this cause-and-effect diagram?

options.label: A
options.text: President Truman orders the Supreme Court to rule on the constitutionality of affirmative action policies.

options.label: B
options.text: President Truman issues an executive order to desegregate the military.

options.label: C
options.text: The Senate passes legislation requiring labor unions to admit African Americans.

options.label: D
options.text: The Senate confirms the nomination of the first African American Supreme Court justice.

visual_elements: cause-and-effect diagram with text boxes and arrows
